text:
sofia (Recruiter): @emily need quick comp exception routing for candidate — counteroffer on table, wants start by 2024-05-06, also has pending H1B transfer timeline. Candidate is asking for base $180k vs our band top $165k. can we stretch band + sign-on? attaching comp notes.

emily (People Ops): Sofia — please paste the comp rationale (market data + counter offer). Is this manager-approved? Also need confirmation on relocation/visa support and whether hiring manager signs off on above-band.

raj (Hiring Manager): Confirmed, I approve bringing to comp committee. Strong fit and urgent. We can commit to start date flexibility but prefer 2024-05-20 if immigration delays. Can we do $15k sign-on + accelerated equity vesting first year? :thumbsup:

leo (Finance): Need budget code and run-rate impact. If base = 180k and $15k sign-on, annual run-rate increase = salary delta + equity estimate. Approvals needed from Eng head and FP&A. Provide compensation table pls.

sofia (Recruiter): Rationale: candidate market comps at 175-185k in SF, counteroffer is 180k. Our band E2 max is 165k. Proposed package:
```
Base: 180000
Sign-on: 15000 (one-time)
Equity: 0.08% 4y, 1y cliff (requested acceleration: 18mo for 50%)
Start date: target 2024-05-06 but flexible to 2024-05-20 w/ visa
```
Manager (raj) ok with sign-on + partial acceleration.

offer-bot: Approval flow started -> comp-exception -> PeopleOpsReview

emily (People Ops): OK routing plan: I'll route to comp committee + CFO for one-off band extension to 180k. Need written manager endorsement (raj), candidate counteroffer copy (sofia), and hiring spreadsheet row. ETA for decision ~24-36h. If approved, will include proration notes for equity and sign-on payment timing.

sofia (Recruiter): Pasting candidate counteroffer excerpt and spreadsheet link: https://redwood.app/sheets/row/xyz

leo (Finance): If committee approves, prefer sign-on paid within 30 days of start. Equity proration: standard quarterly proration; acceleration needs legal review.

raj (Hiring Manager): I'm happy to add written endorsement in thread: I endorse 180k base + 15k sign-on + 18mo partial vest accel. This role impacts product timelines.

emily (People Ops): Got it. Routing now. @offer-bot will ping when committee votes. If committee denies, fallback: we can offer 165k + 25k sign-on OR 165k + accelerated vesting + retention milestone. Heads up to recruiter to prep fallback language.

sofia (Recruiter): Understood — will prep two fallback offers. Candidate prefers cash over equity if forced. will update candidate after committee.

offer-bot: comp-exception request submitted to comp-committee at 2024-03-05T14:12:03Z

sofia (Recruiter): Thanks all — will stand by. :pray:

emily (People Ops): Committee meeting scheduled in ~6h. Will update thread with decision or ask for more info.
